name: cleanupAfterCommit$
replacement: no replacement: the runtime delete after the terminal write is not tracked

name: persistLifecycleFailure$
replacement: no replacement: one terminal write per attempt

name: unappliedCancels
replacement: no replacement: a cancel lives only as long as the decision or attempt it was given to

name: forgetDeletedDocument
replacement: no replacement: a cancel is not kept beyond its decision or attempt

name: FAILED_DECISION_PAUSE_MS
replacement: no replacement: a failure ends the attempt and nothing is tried again by itself

name: failedDecisions
replacement: no replacement: nothing is tried again by itself

name: reattachRunning
replacement: no replacement: the queues start only waiting rows without a link

name: attemptedReattachments
replacement: no replacement: the queues start only waiting rows without a link

replacement: startAgain$ (Start again stores the row waiting; the admission starts it)

name: terminalStage
replacement: no replacement: a terminal write names its own stage

name: startDocument$
replacement: admitWaiting$ (the one admission of the capture service)

name: startWaiting
replacement: admitWaiting$ (the queue stores no longer start captures)

name: startingIds
replacement: no replacement: only the admission starts a capture

name: pendingStart
replacement: no replacement: only the admission starts a capture

name: awaitingTurn
replacement: no replacement: a dropped batch stores waiting rows; the admission gives the turns

name: batchClaims
replacement: no replacement: a dropped batch stores waiting rows; the admission gives the turns

replacement: no replacement: one capture at a time for recordings and documents together

name: captureRetry
